**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Chat
- **Connect an email account (IMAP), read-only.** Ask the chat to connect your mailbox and it shows a password card right in the conversation. The password is stored in your Mac's Keychain and is never sent to the AI model. The chat can then search and read your mail (`mail_search`, `mail_read`) — it cannot send, move or delete anything. Manage connected accounts in Settings → Chat → Mail Accounts.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.31...v8.32
